name: RapidDNS subdomain pages (rapiddns.io, HTML)
tier_rationale: No API terms reviewed and the data comes from scraping public HTML pages (A8 unknown). Chair decision P016: RapidDNS is a separate toggle with terms 'unknown' until legal records a ToS/robots review.

reliability.justification: Passive DNS rows (name, value, type, date) from its own collection; guest pages may be truncated ('Total' above the rows shown) and the HTML layout can change without notice.

subdomain_pages.title: RapidDNS subdomain page (GET /subdomain/{domain}?full=1, HTML table id='table')

terms.quote: myssl.com (CN operator, terms not reviewed) and RapidDNS (HTML scraping) are separate toggles with terms 'unknown' until legal records them; RapidDNS needs a recorded ToS/robots review

subdomain_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P016 cond 3). robots.txt (fetched 2026-11-26) reads 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' plus a Sitemap line; the ToS page was not reviewed yet (legal input missing). Polite scraping: one page per registrable domain, >= 2 s between requests, the neutral V3LUM UA (never a browser UA to pass a wall); challenge pages are BLOCKED 'challenge' and stop the source (A9, P016 cond 9). Off unless setting subdomains_passive_extra_rapiddns is enabled and legal records the review.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-3 (P016, module subdomains_passive_extra, toggle subdomains_passive_extra_rapiddns). The same-IP (reverse IP) pages are not used.
